column5: F2 moved alreadySet (667) to feature.label(). The two left are confirmMutation's bleSettingConfirmed/bleLabelConfirmed(feature.label) (997): that line also holds the "clock_sync", "headlight" and "auto_sensor" ids, so G1 refuses the swap there (ledger_check BleController.java:993 at F2); a follow-up splits the id checks off the line first, then passes feature.label()

F2 moved alreadySet (809) to find(key).label(). The two left are bleReading and bleApplying(find(key).label.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) (817, 934): their lines hold "Try prepared" and "clock_sync", which G1 refuses beside a swap, and they need a mid-sentence form of the label that no batch provides (plan 4.6: no lowercasing); a follow-up adds whole templates per feature or a sentence-case label

F2 shows the other six through refusal(e) (Refused.msg(), the log keeps getMessage()). The two left are setPin and enablePin's catch (700, 701): those lines also hold "Handlebar PIN changes", "pin" and "proximity_key", so G1 refuses notice(refusal(e)) there (ledger_check BleController.java:696 at F2). Safety: the PIN owner check and digits refusals stay English on screen until a follow-up converts simulationUnavailable(...) to whole templates (B7) and moves the ids, then passes refusal(e). Deferred: GuidedTest.trial's IllegalArgumentException("Not offered as a try") and TestJournal's "Test record is invalid" reach BleController startTry() via refusal(e) unmapped and stay English (defensive paths: admitTry/decideTry check first).

F2 moved the test cards (150, 182, 212) to find(feature).label(). The one left is the capability table row label (287): its line holds the "clock_sync" id, so G1 refuses the swap (ledger_check CompatibilityPanel.java:292 at F2); a follow-up moves the id compare off the line
The panel's refresh key (56) joins modelLine(d) with other ids to see when to redraw: data, it stays English. F2 moved the shown title (101) to ModelRegistry.modelLineText

muted(d.reasonText()) and the capability table value (191, 288) render the reason when the panel draws, in the current language already (reasonText() is message(reason).toString()), and nothing logs them, so they show the same as reasonMessage(). F2 leaves them: ControlsConsumersTest requires more than 20 file/pattern rows (its line 80, proof tooling F2 may not edit), and switching them would leave 20

liveTest's from/to (152) stay d.label(v), the English ids: to is what question() compares with "On"/"Off" and "mph" (data, B9 raw values), and the line holds "" so G1 refuses a swap. F2 shows them through d.labelText(v) in compatChangingTo and compatSettingBack, and every other card value and button through d.labelText(v). Open (follow-up): question()'s generic tail light, turn sound and automatic lights sentences still take the lowercased English value; G1 refuses passing the shown label into those lines (they hold "On"/"Off"; ledger_check CompatibilityPanel.java:226 at F2), so a follow-up moves the ids into constants first. B18: MoreScreen:1957 must keep passing an English id (labValue gets it from featureValue, which F2 keeps English); show featureValueText elsewhere
ids, not shown: f.group compares (groupOf, section lists), feature.options as the swatch colour key and optionTexts length, and the English side of inSentence

emailChargeRecordings puts the English model line in Email to Volt's fixed English subject (IssueReport.chargeRecordingsSubject) and body (hub layout plan, PR 4), as the issue report does (MoreScreen 2179): the email goes to Volt's report address, so the model name stays English
rowNote: rendered at display, already in the current language
the English haystack; ControlRow.matchesShown adds feature.label() and description() as shown
decision.label(v) as the swatch colour key; the shown name is decision.labelText(v)

the lowercased content descriptions (1695-1697) are whole templates whose hole is label.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), so English keeps its mid-sentence lower case; they need a lower-case name per feature (plan 4) before a language ships. The slider description (1903) shares its statement with the lab-slider tag, so G1 blocks f.label() there; switch it in a follow-up PR

labModel's fallback line (1631) holds the "your model" literal that stays English (the model phrase is glued into five sentences; whole templates need a G1 choice on labModel's result), and G1 allows no other change around that literal, so the switch to ModelRegistry.modelLineText waits for that follow-up; the issue report (2179) is data and stays modelLine
d.oemLabel(value) in labId is the English id CompatibilityPanel.question chooses its sentence by, never shown; labValue, the shown text, already reads d.oemText(value) (F3)
lab and PIN reasons (1690 twice, 2014, 2559 twice): rendered at display, current language already; the lab value line now joins them as whole templates (more_plain, more_lab_value_reason)
CapabilityResolver.text(reason) default branch (1717): rendered at display, current language already
